Travis Whitaker
Senior Supply Chain & Logistics Operations Manager
Dallas, TX | travis.whitaker@supplychainmail.com | +1 214-555-0145 | linkedin.com/in/traviswhitaker-scm

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Strategic Senior Supply Chain and Logistics Manager with 8+ years of experience optimizing global procurement, inventory planning, warehousing operations, and carrier logistics for multinational manufacturing and retail brands. Expert in SAP S/4HANA ERP, demand forecasting, vendor contract negotiation, and Lean Six Sigma process improvement. Successfully reduced supply chain lead times by 35% and saved $4.5M in freight and inventory carrying costs.

WORK EXPERIENCE
Senior Supply Chain Operations Manager | Apex Logistics Global | Dallas, TX | 2021 - Present
- Managed global procurement and freight logistics budget of $45M across 60+ Tier-1 suppliers in North America, Asia, and Europe.
- Implemented statistical demand forecasting and inventory replenishment models in SAP ERP, cutting excess inventory by 28% while improving on-time order fulfillment to 98.6%.
- Negotiated ocean, air, and domestic intermodal carrier contracts, reducing annual freight shipping expenditures by $2.8M (14% cost reduction).
- Led Lean Six Sigma warehouse automation initiative across 3 distribution fulfillment centers, increasing pick-and-pack throughput by 42%.
- Established rigorous Supplier Scorecard KPIs, improving vendor on-time delivery (OTD) compliance from 78% to 95%.

Supply Chain Specialist | OmniManufacturing Corp | Houston, TX | 2017 - 2021
- Supervised end-to-end purchasing and materials requirement planning (MRP) for a $20M manufacturing assembly facility.
- Managed relationships with third-party logistics (3PL) providers and customs brokers to expedite international import/export clearances.
- Conducted root-cause investigations for shipment exceptions, reducing freight damage and shortage claims by 52%.
- Developed real-time inventory visibility dashboards in Power BI and Excel, eliminating stockouts for critical SKU lines.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Science in Supply Chain & Logistics Management | Texas A&M University | 2013 - 2017

TECHNICAL SKILLS
- Supply Chain Strategy: Global Procurement, Demand Planning & Forecasting, Inventory Optimization, Warehouse Management (WMS), Logistics & Freight Management, Lean Six Sigma
- Software & ERP: SAP S/4HANA, Oracle SCM, NetSuite, Blue Yonder, Manhattan Associates, Power BI, Advanced Excel (Solver, Pivot Tables)
- Metrics & Compliance: Vendor Scorecards, On-Time In-Full (OTIF), Days Sales of Inventory (DSI), Incoterms 2020, Customs & Trade Compliance

CERTIFICATIONS
- Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP) - APICS/ASCM (2022)
- Certified in Production and Inventory Management (CPIM) (2019)
- Lean Six Sigma Green Belt (2020)
jobDescriptionText:
Seeking a Senior Supply Chain Operations Manager to lead logistics and procurement. Requirements:
- 6+ years experience in supply chain, logistics, or global procurement.
- Proficiency in SAP S/4HANA or Oracle SCM, demand forecasting, and inventory planning.
- Proven track record of carrier contract negotiation and operational cost reduction.
- CSCP, CPIM, or Six Sigma certification preferred.
